subject: Dispatch is headless again: retire the auto-fix.sh --prepare subagent path, apply.sh main-repo compare (rc 7) and the #152 agent.cost fold (D-067)

Measured at 85a1eb4: auto-fix.sh 3,203 lines, 47 prepare-related lines (grep -cE); prepare code = lines 9-11, 17-25, 111, 126, 141, 150-171, 1055-1081, 1084-1085, 1092-1096, 1118-1124, 1147, 1193-1198, 3049-3159; apply.sh compare = header row 7 (29-33) and 594-616; main_guard.py CLI = 29-33, 47-48, 346-417 (module functions used by run_agent at auto-fix.sh 1350-1395 stay). Callers after deletion: round_setup -> round_once only, verifier_copy -> start_verifier_bg only (both inlined, A5); archive_copy stays (start_verifier_bg); first_round_dispatch (--dry-run --round 1) untouched. #152 judgment = delete: transcript-cost.DISPATCH only matches a ".../t<n>/<run_id>/dispatch-(verifier-)?round<r>.md" path inside a subagent first prompt; only the --prepare pointer printed one; headless workers run with AC_ROLE=worker so agent-cost-hook.py returns at line 85-87 and their cost is the envelope via write_cost -> ticket.py cost (#58/#94). With no marked event, agent_cost_events never selects a row and fold_agent_cost is dead, so the fold, its SCHEMA wording and 24 cases go (14 in test_agent_cost_hook.py, 10 in test_ticket.py); the #95 guessed event stays. Files that move: scripts/auto-fix.sh, apply.sh, main_guard.py, ticket.py (734, 1234, 1508-1552), agent-cost-hook.py (11-12, 24-26, 130-133), transcript-cost.py (7, 11, 52-54, 176-183); tests/test_auto_fix.py, test_agent_cost_hook.py, test_ticket.py; docs/SESSION-START.md 37-50, DISPATCH-TEMPLATE.md 63-65 72-73 105, WORKFLOW.md 180-186, reference/role-procedures.md 171 173-181, tickets/SCHEMA.md 30-32. Pinning tests found by grep: the 59 deleted (A8; round-1 objection added PrepareSubagentCostOnClose and corrected AgentCostFoldsOnClose to 4) plus test_v153_a9_docs_follow and test_v153_t12 (edited). Not touched: sync-to-project.sh (hard_block, user edits the D-066 note), DECISIONS.md, HANDOFF.md, docs/review/, code-map (apply regenerates). Oracle checked for "assertions unchanged": tests/test_apply.py and test_sync_to_project.py have no prepare / snapshot / compare assertion; verify/ and templates/ have none. Rulings written into the ticket as the opener's recommendation, flip before Ready if the main line disagrees: Q1 delete the routine fallback section (its step 3 needs --prepare; alternative: keep steps 1-2 and rewrite 3 for headless receipt). Q2 delete the main_guard.py CLI (zero callers; alternative: keep as a debugging command). Q3 delete the #152 fold (above). complex: touches dispatch and receipt. needs_verifier=true: the verifier adds positive absence cases (T2, T4, T7, T8) the worker's greps cannot give. interface_fixed=false on purpose: the verifier appends to the same three test modules the worker deletes classes from, so it starts after the worker commit to avoid a patch-verify conflict. Order: auto-fix.sh + apply.sh + main_guard.py first, then #152 trio, then tests, then docs, then the wc / grep table.
